headline: SEA @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.23 at CHW 3.90, with a projected total of 8.13. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (SEA -0.32, CHW -0.22), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.54, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Davis Martin has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Julio Rodríguez, Josh Naylor, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Cal Raleigh, Leo Rivas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
